Connecting Your Prop Firm to NinjaTrader

Every prop firm you use issues its own unique Tradovate username and password. This walks you through finding those credentials, logging in to Tradovate with each set, and signing the market data agreement that allows live data into your NinjaTrader.

Follow along with the walkthrough video. Your progress is saved on this device.

0 of 5 steps complete

Tick each step as you go.

  1. 1

    Find your Tradovate credentials in each prop firm dashboard

    2 min

    Every prop firm you use issues its own unique Tradovate username and password. You need those credentials before you can connect anything.

    1. Sign in to the prop firm's dashboard once you have purchased an account (example shown: Lucid Trading).
    2. Every prop firm has a dashboard; the credentials location differs per firm but is usually next to the account.
    3. For Lucid it is the Show Credentials button at the top of the Account Summary page.
    4. That reveals the Tradovate username and password for that account.
    You will have a separate set of credentials for each firm: one for Lucid, one for My Funded Futures, one for Blue Sky, and so on. Different prop firms keep these credentials in different places: they may be under User Credentials, under a key icon on the main dashboard of the website, or under Tradovate Credentials.
    0:00
  2. 2

    Record the credentials for every prop firm in one document

    2 min

    You are going to need these credentials to log in to Tradovate, and having every firm's set in one place keeps the process quick.

    1. Start a document (Notepad or Word, whatever you like).
    2. For each prop firm, copy the Tradovate username and paste it in the document.
    3. Copy the password and put it right next to the username.
    4. Keep a record like this for every prop firm you are using.
    1:00
  3. 3

    Log in to Tradovate with each credential set

    2 min

    Tradovate is where the prop firm accounts live; each credential set gets logged in once so its agreement can be signed.

    1. Go to tradovate.com.
    2. Log in using the username and password you recorded for the first prop firm.
    3. Always select Simulated Trading when logging in.
    The very first time you log in with a credential set you will not reach the dashboard right away; an agreement pops up first.
    2:10
  4. 4

    Sign the market data agreement

    1 min

    Signing this agreement is what allows you to have live data in your NinjaTrader.

    1. On the pop-up, choose Non-Professional. Always choose Non-Professional.
    2. Push Next.
    3. On the next page, check off the two boxes that say I agree.
    4. Sign your name at the bottom. Spell your name exactly the way it is written on that form.
    5. Push OK. That brings you to your dashboard.
    Non-Professional just means you are not managing someone else's money, not part of a board or exchange, and do not hold a Series 7 or similar license.
    2:46
  5. 5

    Repeat for every prop firm

    2 min per firm

    Each prop firm's credential set has its own agreement; every one must be signed the same way.

    1. If you have multiple prop firms, log out of Tradovate.
    2. Go back to your credentials document and take the next firm's username and password (for example My Funded Futures).
    3. Log in the same way and sign that same agreement.
    4. Do that for every platform.
    3:33

  6. You are connected

    Every prop firm credential set has been logged in to Tradovate and its market data agreement is signed. Live data can now flow into your NinjaTrader for each of those accounts. Keep your credentials document handy; you will use the same logins going forward.

Important: Vincere licenses automated trading software; the client makes all trading and brokerage decisions. Platform screens may change; confirm current details directly with your prop firm and Tradovate. Futures trading involves substantial risk of loss.
